newsitem.title: USA: Glenayre faces class action lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Glenayre faces class action lawsuit.

text.p: Glenayre Technologies Inc shareholders have filed a class action lawsuit against the company, alleging violations of U.S. securities law, the plaintiffs' lawyers said on Monday.

The suit, filed in a U.S. District Court on behalf of people who bought or otherwise acquired Glenayre common stock between January 4, 1996 and September 13, 1996, alleged the company and certain officers and directors made numerous references to a firm order backlog, when the backlog was not firm, the lawyers said.
Glenayre was not immediately available to comment.

The complaint, which alleged violations of the U.S. Securities Exchange Act of 1934, also alleged that Glenayre's share price was artificially inflated during the class period because of a series of materially false and misleading financial statements, the lawyers said.

Plaintiffs, who sought to recover damages, were represented by Milberg Weiss Bershad Hynes & Lerach LLP, Bernstein Leibhard & Lifshitz, Savett Frutkin Podell & Ryan, P.C., and the Law Office of Bernard M. Gross, P.C.
